why: M3 audit round 2 (Devin) filed F-M3-07 and round 7 F-M3-30, its duplicate: holon audit regress compares each version of a law file with the previous commit of a path-limited topological log, not with the commit's own parents, so on branchy history it reports statement-hash changes no commit made (680 uncovered on round 2's range, 408 on fe1f88f2..ef39bed5) and leaves out ones commits did make (224). The lead's triage raised F-M3-07 to medium for the second direction and left it open at the M3 exit (docs/M3_EXIT.md). The key I102 is their fix. This line pins the contract docstring of tests_m3/test_regress_parents_i102.py at the prereg.

Found at the build's first run of B3. The preregistered check asserted that no M3 change is reported at the merge 41c7e34 at all. It read F-M3-30's 'at the merge 41c7e34 every law equals its first parent 515b450a' as covering every law, but that sentence is about the 136 laws the base reported there. The fixed tool reports 8 other changes at 41c7e34: laws that the first parent does not hold and that the second holds under statement-hash scheme 1. The merge migrated each to scheme 2, and its hash_migration line covers it (line 1148 for L_disch_self_Rollup_challengeState_489_493). They are real changes the merge made. The amended check asserts two things. None of the 136 laws that round 7 recorded as the base's uncovered changes at 41c7e34 (audit/rounds/M3/round7/a3/regress_fe1f88f2_to_target.summary.json, its uncovered list) is reported there. Every change reported there is covered. Every other assertion is unchanged: no uncovered M3 change on the range, parent_check's empty recheck, hidden_check's 0. The contract docstring and the key are unchanged.

Found at the build's first run of B4, with the same defect as B3's line above. The preregistered check asserted that no M3 change is reported at the merges 41c7e34 and ecbb695 at all, but F-M3-07's 'at 41c7e34 and ecbb695 the registry hash equals the first parent's' is about the 136 laws it names, every M3 law of round 1. At 41c7e34 the fixed tool reports 8 other changes: the merge's hash_migration of laws the first parent does not hold, each covered (see B3's line). The amended check asserts two things. None of round 1's 136 M3 laws (laws/M3/L*.json at round 1's target 2b4578af) is reported at 41c7e34 or ecbb695. Every change reported there is covered. Every other assertion is unchanged: no uncovered M3 change on the range, and nothing for the L_pinit law at 38d66f5 or 4f0f51b. The contract docstring and the key are unchanged.

Found when M6's I105 (#170) ran CI. B7 diffs its base 82134fff against HEAD, so after I102 landed it judges every later key's commits too: I105's generator changes (holon/machine.py, holon/sorts/model3.py) fail it, though I102 changed no closure file. Its contract is that I102's own change moves no generator closure. The amended check takes the files changed by I102's own commits: the first-parent non-merge commits from the base 82134fff to I102's landed head 1f209ff7, the second parent of the lead's merge 95c9ef34 (#166). It computes the closure as it stood at that landed head, in a detached worktree. The closure computation, its inputs and the assertion (no file in both sets) are unchanged. This narrows B7 to its own key's commits, as HUMAN_ANSWERS Q48 narrowed I48-R3 and I52-B7.
